title: Compressible Flow
description: Faster than sound, air stops getting out of the way and starts piling up into shocks, and a nozzle works backwards: it must widen to speed the gas up. That is the De Laval nozzle of every rocket. Unlocks the De Laval Nozzle, which also lets the MHD Generator run its plasma supersonic.

puzzle.goal: A nozzle exhausts an ideal gas at Mach number M. The speed of sound in a gas of heat-capacity ratio γ, temperature T and molar mass m is √(γRT/m). Write v, the exhaust speed.
puzzle.name: Supersonic exhaust
puzzle.form: M * sqrt ( γ * R * T / m )
puzzle.expr: M * sqrt ( γ * R * T / m )
puzzle.ask: Find v in m/s: M = @{M}, γ = @{γ}, R = @{R} J/(mol·K), T = @{T} K, m = @{m} kg/mol.
puzzle.method: Sound is a pressure wave; it travels at √(∂p/∂ρ) at constant entropy, which for an ideal gas is √(γRT/m). Mach number is speed over that.
